title: Freedom in Christ
definition: Freedom in Christ is the believer's liberation from condemnation, slavery to sin, and bondage to man-made righteousness.
summary: Freedom in Christ is liberation from condemnation, slavery to sin, and bondage to man-made righteousness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the liberating Savior who makes His people truly free.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Freedom in Christ is not permission to live for the flesh. It is release from condemnation and false masters so the believer can serve God in love. This doctrine brings together liberty, holiness, conscience, and joyful obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people often confuse freedom with self-rule. True freedom is found under the gracious lordship of Jesus, not in slavery to desire or fear. It also protects believers from being bound by human traditions where Christ has not bound them.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stand firm against both legalistic bondage and sinful license. Use your freedom to love, serve, forgive, and obey. Ask whether your choices display liberty in Christ or a new form of slavery.
